main_text.head: V.
main_text.p: Quia Idea Dei tantam realitatem objectivam in se continet, ut illam mens nostra non nisi à solo Deo realiter existente potuerit accipere, firmissimè inde concluditur Dei existentia.
main_text.head: VI.
main_text.p: A Dei sive Entis summè perfecti existentia omnis certitudo humanarum scientiarum dependet, adeò ut, nisi sciamus Deum existere, ne quidem certò scire possimus ter tria esse novem.
main_text.head: VII.
main_text.p: Mens nostra solâ voluntate potest movere corpus.
main_text.head: VIII.
main_text.p: Id quod imago quaedam divinæ potentiæ est: Deus enim produxit, quaecunque produxit, solâ voluntate.
main_text.head: FINIS

page.notes: The ornament below FINIS is a printer's fleuron, not transcribed. The page is a numbered list of theses (V–VIII) set in italic type; the numerals are kept as printed in the body as headings. Long s is rendered as s throughout.
